svg.title: Color authoring and evaluated constraints
svg.desc: A synchronous runtime composes cyclic hue edits and sparse ownership claims through per-handle policy effects, then the adapter commits settings and claims in one scope. Peak and actual node-owned time changes clear claims. Invalid animated samples use closest-angle and radial constraints without rewriting keyframes.

g.text: loop handle claimed by this origin
edit; current settings and sparse claims
capture current offset when authorized; move handle
solve all owned restorations together under valid gaps
clear matched claim / retain blocked claim
apply both authorized replacements in one edit scope
compare math signature and separate undo fingerprint
clear claims; resolve hues and Adaptance together
clear node-owned claims; shared claims survive
closest squared-angle projection; radial Adaptance limit
prepare effective result; never rewrite keys
